summary: The save/sync row implementation matches the spec exactly. Verified index.html: #wb-save-sync-row is a body-level element sandwiched exactly between </header> and .toolbar (not inside header, not inside #toolbar-groups), its five children are in the required order with every id/class/onclick/oncontextmenu/data-i/data-i-title/title byte-preserved, and the header's .header-actions now ends cleanly with Export HTML. A new 23-check Playwright suite (tests/01-move-salveaza-and-sincronizeaza-buttons-like/row.js) covers structure, geometry (one line, left-aligned, ordered left edges, no wrap/squash, vertical-centre alignment within 2px) at 1920/1440/1024/800/700/390/360px plus a 740x360 landscape phone, the 360px sideways-scroll behavior including scrollLeft=9999 reaching the last button, the ☰ toolbar-collapse leaving the row and its buttons visible and clickable, background-color/border-bottom parity with the header, RO and EN labels (including #wb-cloud-where's disconnected text), Ctrl+S/Ctrl+Alt+S keyboard shortcuts, direct clicks (including right-click on #btn-wb-cloud) reaching their onclick/oncontextmenu handlers post-move, resizing without a reload, and the absence of hardcoded hex colours in the row's CSS. All 23 checks pass with zero page errors. The spec's Done-means item 9 suites were also run: node tests/verify.js passes; from tests/, gdsync.js, wbsaveall.js and wbadopt.js all pass; idea.js and nav.js show exactly their pre-existing known failures (CLAUDE.md known issues 1 and 3) and nothing new. No bugs were found.
